question: Which recurring customer concerns should contact-centre leadership review first?

window.label: All dates
window.explanation: Data spans 01 Aug 2025 to 02 Dec 2025; no date filter applied.

headline: Leadership should review Item or service not received first (priority score 67.1), then Coupon not applying, Duplicate charge.
answer: Across 3000 conversations (all dates), Item or service not received ranks first. Item or service not received: 338 conversations (11% of scope), 39% negative, 54% end unresolved, 53% closing actions misfit the issue. Stands out most on negative rate relative to the other concerns; that signal contributes 25.0 of its 67.1 priority points. Suggested action: Run a root-cause review of negative conversations for this issue with the owning product team. Owner: Customer experience lead.

method_notes: priority = Σ weight × min-max normalised signal across concerns, scaled to 0–100.
Weights: Volume 0.30, Negative rate 0.25, Escalation requests / conv. 0.15, Ends unresolved 0.15, Resolution misfit 0.10, Month-on-month change 0.05.
A concern is the primary issue raised in the customer's opening message.
A conversation is negative when the mean sentiment score of its customer turns is -0.25 or lower.
Months are assigned by each conversation's earliest timestamp.
Fit uses the documented issue→action mapping in ASSUMPTIONS.md; general help requests are excluded as not assessable.
